acceptance_criteria.criterion: Trace and cutover: production hunter-agent-execute no longer relies on legacy Railway model execution and reaches the #524 replacement execution/publication boundary through the existing governed SPM/DPM path; rehearsal remains structurally non-publishing.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: compose_services builds only GitHubHostedExecutionRuntime and main enables admission only for it; the authorization is admitted after claim, GovernedEngineeringTaskIngress -> SmartPromptMachine (EngineeringContextAuthority/DPM) compilation and durable handoff recording. tests/test_issue_agent_github_execution.py::test_label_acceptance_reaches_the_replacement_executor_through_spm_dpm, ::test_production_composition_never_builds_the_legacy_railway_runtime, ::test_production_main_enables_admission_only_for_the_github_runtime. Rehearsal workflow unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Authority and credential isolation: provider has no repository-write/signing/publication authority, publisher has no model authority and runs no candidate code, signed authorization + exact base + TaskScope + result digest stay bound, publication is create-only and replay-safe.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Separate execute/validate/publish jobs with per-job secrets; model and candidate pre-push run as non-root hunter-untrusted via sudo -n -u ... env -i allowlist; publish_create_only runs no hook and binds the signed commit to the credential-free safety tree. tests/test_issue_agent_github_execution.py::test_workflow_runs_each_trust_domain_in_its_own_job, ::test_model_runs_as_the_isolation_user_without_any_oidc_or_issuer_capability, tests/test_issue_agent_replacement_executor.py::test_candidate_pre_push_receives_only_an_explicit_allowlist_as_the_isolation_user, ::test_publisher_refuses_a_tree_the_safety_boundary_did_not_prove, ::test_publisher_refuses_existing_branch_before_building_commit.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: SPM/DPM proof: no implementation without valid SPM handoff; DPM/EngineeringContextAuthority consumed before implementation; provider-direct execution without signed handoff fails closed.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_issue_agent_github_execution.py::test_an_invalid_spm_handoff_releases_no_prompt, ::test_no_implementation_without_the_admitted_signed_handoff, ::test_resolver_failure_is_terminal_and_never_executes, and the exact prompt asserted to carry ENGINEERING_CONTEXT_SCHEMA_VERSION in ::test_label_acceptance_reaches_the_replacement_executor_through_spm_dpm.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Trigger/retry semantics: owner-only label remains the authorization trigger; invalid events fail closed; retry/replay cannot create a second claim, branch or Draft PR; transport retry never changes signed bytes.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Trigger authorization unchanged; OIDC binds repository/owner/actor/issues event/trusted workflow_ref/GitHub-hosted runner and the first executor run id+attempt; every role op single-use. tests/test_issue_agent_github_execution.py::test_execution_is_bound_to_one_run_and_every_role_is_single_use, ::test_a_replayed_authorization_is_never_admitted_twice, ::test_a_second_authorization_branch_cannot_open_a_second_pr_for_the_issue; existing tests/test_issue_agent_trigger.py transport retry tests pass.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: Owner-gated post-merge/deploy step: Issue #557 requires #520 be re-authorized only after this PR merges and deploys; it is the completion evidence, not a property of this pre-merge candidate.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Regression / DPM learning: observed no-cutover failure reproduced; hostile tests for legacy execution, provider publication, credential co-residency, stale/replay, duplicate publication, candidate code under publisher credentials; defect linked to existing family.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: PRH-066..072 recorded under existing DFF-027/DFF-028 (no new family); regressions listed in those families' regression_evidence; Defect Prevention Guard and Artifact Guard pass at push.

defect_families.evidence: OIDC exp/iat/nbf are judged against the issuer's own clock (runtime clock), never a caller value; result timeout uses monotonic time.
Execution state transitions (run binding, role use, handoff_delivered, result acceptance) are read and written under one runtime lock; ledger writes keep the existing owner/lease predicates.

Branch, base and authorization identity derive only from the signed authorization (derive_execution_target); a result naming another authorization/base/branch is rejected (tests/test_issue_agent_github_execution.py::test_a_misbound_result_is_rejected_and_terminal).

Unknown request keys, roles, schemas, malformed OIDC claims (aud/nbf/job_workflow_ref) and missing configuration all fail closed (tests/test_issue_agent_github_execution.py::test_malformed_audience_claims_fail_closed, ::test_a_present_job_workflow_ref_must_name_the_trusted_workflow).
No new durable persistence of content: the hostile result and prompt are held only in issuer memory under the lease; ReplacementResultLedger stores digests only.
Issuer restart lapses the existing lease and fails the row closed (PROCESS_RESTART); hosted state is never reconstructed or replayed after restart.

Every role operation is single-use and bound to one workflow run id+attempt; replayed, cross-run and re-run requests are refused (tests/test_issue_agent_github_execution.py::test_execution_is_bound_to_one_run_and_every_role_is_single_use).
Validation receipts bind the exact result digest and validation definition; the publisher verifies them and the signed authorization before publishing.
The executor authenticates with GitHub OIDC verified against GitHub's RS256 keys, not caller metadata (tests/test_issue_agent_github_execution.py::test_oidc_token_authenticity_and_time_fail_closed).
All commits in this range are authored and committed as the bound writer Farhad5778 and SSH-signed; the publisher derives its Git identity from CODE_WRITE_POLICY writer_identity_binding.
Ordinary forward commits pushed through the pre-push boundary; no rewind or force-push used to manufacture evidence.
This candidate writes no connector authorization receipt.
This document is the exact-head review request for the complete base->HEAD range; authority is supplied out of band by the trusted collector.
No change to pending/failure publication of hosted prerequisites.
DFF-027/DFF-028 keep their lifecycle and machine bindings; only resolvable regression evidence was added, verified by the Defect Prevention Guard and tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py.
No validation-proof reuse change; full pytest proof remains the hosted exact-head Pre-PR stage.
Railway startup bootstrap ordering unchanged; the issuer still composes only after bootstrap and key scrubbing.
Hosted runtime is the existing fallback seam under the existing owner/lease semantics; completion/failure use the claiming instance's ledger writes.
Accepted hosted executions run on the existing tracked non-daemon workers and reach a terminal ledger outcome (result, rejection or EXECUTOR_RESULT_TIMEOUT).
Merge Readiness logic unchanged.
prepare_authorization still runs Source Handling preflight before the ledger claim; admission to the hosted runtime happens only after claim, compile and record_dispatch.
No governance authority cutover change.

Production composes only the GitHub-hosted runtime; runner trust is the GitHub-hosted platform asserted by the verified runner_environment claim; OIDC binding fixed for direct workflows (PRH-071) and job checkouts pinned to github.workflow_sha (PRH-072).

Candidate pre-push runs only in the credential-free validate job as hunter-untrusted with an explicit allowlist; publisher runs no hook and binds to the safety tree; trusted collection never reads model-written Git config (PRH-067, PRH-068).
Candidate branch publication only enables hosted Pre-PR Preflight; the Draft PR is opened only by the existing Candidate PR workflow after it succeeds.
New tracked files use plain ASCII paths loadable by their consumers.
Executor issuer calls are single, bounded (120s) and never retried; the issuer waits under one explicit result timeout.
New tests assert only repository-owned state with local stand-ins for GitHub OIDC keys, the model and the git remote.

Each hosted job installs exactly the pinned wheels its entrypoint imports (cryptography, PyYAML, SQLAlchemy; plus push-safety tools for validate) after a missing-PyYAML import was reproduced in a clean environment; asserted by tests/test_issue_agent_github_execution.py::test_workflow_runs_each_trust_domain_in_its_own_job.
No Smart Prompt Machine or EngineeringContextAuthority change.
The hosted chain is event-driven within one workflow run (needs: authorize -> execute -> validate -> publish); the Draft PR remains created by the existing workflow_run on Pre-PR Preflight.
